results.title: Little Nemo 1909-09-19.jpg
results.description:
Little Nemo   comic strip by  Winsor McCay .
The tune in the strip cartoon is a musically humorous take on the waltz from  "In Happy Slumberland", (starting 'Do you believe in dreams, dear?'), No. 28 in Act III from Victor Herbert's extravaganza  Little Nemo , lyrics by  Harry B. Smith , based on Winsor McCay's cartoons of the same name.  Piano score  (1908), pages 132-134. MIDI file is  here . 
Original score and lyrics:
 
    Herbert, Victor and Smith, Harry Bache, "In Happy Slumberland : Trio" (1908).   
  Vocal Popular Sheet Music Collection . Score 4866. 
  https://digitalcommons.library.umaine.edu/mmb-vp/4866   
  Sheet music
